aggregate_minimal_algorithm: Require both exact owner closures successful and both ordinary verification.json records verified (measurement_controls_verified/build_to_ready_metrics_verified/restored_original_build_and_execution_verified; AA also identical_build_isolated_caches_verified).

For each history rebuild a unique mapping by (cycle,state,mode) from full raw24 rows. Retain only cycle0/state1..5 for ratios; reject missing/duplicate states, NaN/infinity/nonpositive times or nonsuccessful calls. Keep all controls in report outside ratios.
Cross-check summary comparison rows against raw complete-command fields. Compute AB_i=ab[(0,i,candidate)].seconds / ab[(0,i,baseline)].seconds and AA_i analogously for i1..5.

B=statistics.median(AB_i); V=statistics.median(abs(AA_i-1) for i1..5). Continue iff B+V<1; equality or greater parks this unchanged performance path. Do not use ratio of medians, median difference, baseline std cost, or build-to-ready ratio for this decision.

Retain all five ratios/history, B,V,B+V, exact input digests, native/CPU/build comparisons, all cold/wrong/restoration subtotals and outer totals. performance_target_met/final_latency_qualified remain false regardless screen outcome.
